# hackrf

**Host tools for HackRF — transfer, sweep, spectrum and firmware utilities**

- **Version recorded:** 2024.02.1
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `rf-security`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/greatscottgadgets/hackrf>

## What it does

The host-side utilities for HackRF hardware: hackrf_info, hackrf_transfer for raw IQ in and out, hackrf_sweep for wideband spectrum, and the firmware and CPLD flashing tools.

## Why you would want it

hackrf_info is the diagnostic that tells you whether the board is seen, what firmware it runs, and whether permissions are right. hackrf_sweep is the fastest way to see a very wide slice of spectrum at once, which no GUI does as directly.

## Before it will work

HackRF hardware, the udev rules and plugdev membership from the hardware catalog.

## How it installs

- apt: `hackrf`

## Known problems

Host tools and device firmware are version-locked; hackrf_info reports a mismatch and it is worth reading. Debian 13 and Parrot ship 2024.02.1 while Kali ships 2026.01.3 (apt-cache policy, 2026-08-28), so the firmware you flash should match the tools your distribution gave you. This is a transmit-capable radio: transmitting into an unterminated port risks the hardware.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
